fi-cyprinus-carpio.title: Koi
fi-cyprinus-carpio.summary: Ornamental carp kept as colorful pond fish. They grow large, need big outdoor ponds with strong filtration, and are not suitable long-term for typical indoor aquariums.
rows: Pond koi commonly reach 18–36 in; FishBase max length about large (pond-sized)
Outdoor pond preferred (hundreds of gallons). Not a standard aquarium fish once past juvenile size
Peaceful with other koi; may outcompete small fish for food
Social — keep with other koi when space allows
Omnivore. Quality koi pellets plus occasional vegetables and treats; avoid overfeeding
Cold-tolerant; roughly 59–77°F (15–25°C) for active feeding, survive cooler winters in deep ponds
Easy only with adequate pond space and filtration; heavy waste producers
Domesticated forms of common carp (East Asia breeding tradition)
notes: Assorted color and butterfly/long-fin juvenile koi in the shop share this carp entry.
Plan for pond life — indoor tanks are only temporary for small fish.
warn: Outgrow aquariums quickly — plan a pond or rehoming path.
